customManagers.description: Bump the CI workflow's setup-go go-version in step with the toolchain, so a Go security patch clears govulncheck everywhere at once.
Track the govulncheck pin in the CI workflow (go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@vX.Y.Z) so the scanner itself does not go stale.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge Go patch/security releases (go.mod toolchain, the CI go-version, and the Dockerfile base) and base-image digest refreshes. A red govulncheck otherwise blocks the publish job and stops all deploys, so these should not wait for a human.
